dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent light-intensity 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are visible on the dorsal surface. These exhibit a sharp contrast gradient between the dark exterior fur and the high-intensity ring perimeter. dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized, high-intensity white pixel clusters are found in the anterior region. These clusters are dense and lack internal gradients, appearing as solid-fill irregular polygons.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most distinct mid-dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle. The two posterior-most centroids are aligned vertically, while the third is offset anteriorly and ventrally.
